title: Faster start, less RAM, the new Tester window
summary: This build starts faster, gives about 1 GB of RAM back once the game is loaded, fixes the updater on Windows and brings the Custom Skybox to 1.21.10 / 1.21.11. Go through the list below one by one - if something is broken, the report window takes a screenshot or a short video and always sends your logs with it.
changes: New Tester window: test plan, reports with screenshots / videos, live logs
Faster game start (block shapes on all CPU cores, cloak library read faster) and ~1 GB less RAM in the menu
Updater: downloads and unpacks in the background, Install & Restart restarts straight into the new version
Custom Skybox is drawn behind clouds and everything else, cheaper - and now on 1.21.10 / 1.21.11 too
Low Latency Mode (new, off by default) and a throttle for a hidden game window
Fixes: time changer kept by servers, keybind typing into the search box, doubled cloaks, Minecraft cape under Velo cloaks, crosshairs off-centre, player heads

test.title: This Tester window
test.how: Send one test report from the Report page with a screenshot (Paste screenshot works too). Check the Logs page shows your launcher and game logs live.

test.title: Game start
test.how: Start the game a few times. Does it feel faster than before? Anything black, missing or crashing?

test.title: RAM in the menu
test.how: Wait 10 seconds on the title screen, then look at Task Manager (Windows) / System Monitor. Roughly how much does Minecraft use now?

test.title: Custom Skybox
test.how: R-Shift > Custom Skybox. Are clouds, water and lyrics in front of the sky? On 1.21.10 / 1.21.11: does it show at all?

test.title: Time changer on servers
test.how: Time, Weather & Fog > set a fixed time, join a server and wait a minute. Does the time stay?

test.title: Changing keybinds
test.how: Controls / Velo keybinds: type something in the search, click a keybind and press a letter. Does the letter end up in the search box?

test.title: Cloaks
test.how: Wear a Velo cloak. Is your Minecraft cape gone under it? Is any cloak listed twice in the Locker?

test.title: Custom crosshair
test.how: Equip a custom crosshair. Is it exactly in the middle?

test.title: Low Latency Mode
test.how: Turn it on (R-Shift > Low Latency Mode), play a bit. Does aiming feel more direct? FPS drop is expected.

test.title: Hidden window
test.how: Windows / Mac: put a browser fullscreen over the game for a minute. Does the PC get quieter? Does the game come back instantly?
